questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Three novels and two story books had been written by him before 2020.

options.text: He has been writing three novels and two story books before 2020.
He had been writing three novels and two story books before 2020.
He had written three novels and two story books before 2020.
He wrote three novels and two story books before 2020.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'He had written three novels and two story books before 2020.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice. We have to change the sentence into the active form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'past perfect tense' form. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Passive Voice: Object + had + been + V3 + by + Subject
 
• Active Voice: Subject + had + V3 + Object.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Passive voice: The book had been ordered by him.
 
• Active voice: He had ordered the book.
 
 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Three novels and two story books' and the subject of the given sentence is 'him.'
 
• The subject 'him' will be changed into 'He.'
 
• So, in the active voice, the position of ‘object’ and ‘subject’ will be interchanged and 'by' will be removed. 
 
• Also here, 'had been written' will be changed into 'had written.'
 
• The remaining part will not be changed.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *He had written three novels and two story books before 2020.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Birds’ heart, lungs and

P. uptake and intensive exertion compared

Q. to humans, which enables them to function

R. efficiently at these very high altitudes

S. muscles are more efficient for oxygen
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. "SPQR." 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence S is the first part of the sentence as it begins with the '**Birds’ heart, lungs and**' so we have to use a word related to birds body which is **'muscles.'** The sentence starts with the topic of discussion - the efficiency of birds' heart, lungs, and muscles in high-altitude environments. It states that birds' muscles are more efficient for oxygen uptake.
 
• Sentence P is the second part of the sentence as it begins with 'uptake and intensive exertion' and then continues by stating that birds' muscles are more efficient for oxygen uptake and intensive exertion compared to humans. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 3.
 
• Sentence Q is the third part of the sentence as it raises the question that what is the function of the efficiency of oxygen uptake and intensive exertion. Thus it builds a relationship with the previous and upcoming parts.
 
• 
 
Sentence R is the last part of the sentence as it concludes by stating the answer to the previous question that this efficiency is what enables birds to function efficiently at these very high altitudes, emphasizing the significance of their unique physiological adaptations.

 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

The correct order is:__ 

Birds’ heart, lungs and

**S.** muscles are more efficient for oxygen

**P.** uptake and intensive exertion compared

**Q. **to humans, which enables them to function

**R.** efficiently at these very high altitudes

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'past continuous tense.'
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + was/were + (verb+ing) + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + was/were + being + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:

• The remaining portion will not be changed. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Banners were being prepared by them with different designs for the sports meet.*

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. Basically, “smart farming” is applying information and data technologies for optimizing complex farming systems.

Q. With these tools, farmers can monitor field conditions without going to the field.

R. The focus is on access to data and how farmers can use the collected information intelligently.

S. The technology used in smart farming range from IoT and robotics to drones and AI.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. "PRSQ." 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence P is the first sentence as it begins with 'Basically, “smart farming”' and introduces the topic of the paragraph, which is "smart farming." It defines what smart farming is and how it uses information and data technologies.
 
• Sentence R is the second sentence as it builds upon the first sentence and explains the purpose that the focus of smart farming is on access to data and how farmers can use the collected information intelligently.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 3.
 
• Sentence S is the third sentence as it elaborates on the technology used in smart farming, which includes IoT, robotics, drones, and AI. This provides more context and helps the reader understand what specific technologies are used in smart farming.
 
• Sentence Q is the final sentence provides an example of how the technology is used in smart farming. It explains how farmers can monitor field conditions without going to the field. This sentence provides a practical example of how smart farming works, making it an appropriate conclusion to the paragraph.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

The correct order is:__ 

**P.** Basically, “smart farming” is applying information and data technologies for optimizing complex farming systems.

**R.** The focus is on access to data and how farmers can use the collected information intelligently.

**S.** The technology used in smart farming range from IoT and robotics to drones and AI.

**Q.** With these tools, farmers can monitor field conditions without going to the field.

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Ramita said, “I wish I didn’t have to meet my step-mother.”

options.text: Ramita said she wished she hadn’t have to meet her step-mother.
Ramita said she wished she didn’t meet her step-mother.
Ramita said she wished she didn’t have to meet her step-mother.
Ramita said she wished hadn’t met her step-mother.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'Ramita said she wished she didn’t have to meet her step-mother.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The given sentence is an optative sentence.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech 'said' will not be changed because the reporting verb has no object.
 
• The indirect speech will begin like 'Ramita said.'
 
 
 
• **The Tense used in the sentence **after **wish/ if only,** etc.** does not change in indirect speech.**
 
 
• **​**Example:- 
 
 
• She said to him, “Wish you were here.” 
 
• She wished that he was there.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence**, '**didn’t have to**' **will be as it is in the indirect speech.
 
• Here the pronoun 'I' will be changed into 'she' twice.
 
• The pronoun 'my' will be changed into 'her' twice.
 
• The present form of the verb 'wish' will be changed into the past form 'wished.'
 
• The remaining part will not change.
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is 'Ramita said she wished she didn’t have to meet her step-mother.'
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Sentence:__ *Ramita said she wished she didn’t have to meet her step-mother.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__***

 
• The modal verb "**didn't have to**" in the direct speech remains the same in the indirect speech because** it refers to a present or future action that has not yet occurred** at the time of reporting.
 
• Therefore, "didn't have to" does not change to "had not."
